text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm Nishino Flower. Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I know I still have a long ways to go, but
my goal
is to be an inspiration to others.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Which means I first need to be someone
people can depend on. So if there's
anything I can do to
help, please call on
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
